root_cause.text: In XFS AIL push callbacks (`xfs_inode_item_push()` and `xfs_qm_dquot_logitem_push()`), the code dropped `lip->li_ailp->ail_lock` to do buffer I/O and then later re-read `lip->li_ailp`, but the log item could be reclaimed and freed during that window, causing a use-after-free dereference of the freed log item’s `li_ailp` pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch saves `struct xfs_ail *ailp = lip->li_ailp;` before `spin_unlock()`, then replaces later `spin_lock(&lip->li_ailp->ail_lock)` / `spin_unlock(&lip->li_ailp->ail_lock)` with `ailp->ail_lock`, and adds comments stating “The buffer no longer protects the log item from reclaim, so do not reference lip after this point.”
